invariants.text: Project.project_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
A project's status must be updated only when the project is actively being modified by a user.
When a project is deleted, its is_deleted field must be set to true.
A project that has is_deleted set to true must not be returned in any normal listing operation.
Only projects with is_deleted set to false can be returned in a normal listing operation.
The status field of a project must reflect the current state of the project, such as active, inactive, or completed.
A project's name must be unique across all projects in the system.
A project's description is optional and may be empty.
